messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D Minecraft-style voxel island game with a day/night cycle.

## Requirements
- The game must be playable, with a polished voxel-island presentation.
- Support desktop and mobile touch controls.
- Include mining, placing, movement, jumping, inventory selection, and a changing sky.

## Decisions
- Used a static `index.html` Three.js implementation loaded via CDN.
- Assumed a self-contained browser game served at port 3002.
- Used a gentle fantasy presentation with an introductory welcome panel.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the island terrain, water, shoreline, trees, flowers, crystals, path, lookout, and avatar.
- Implemented desktop movement, camera drag, jumping, mining, placing, hotbar selection, and collection stats.
- Implemented mobile joystick and action controls.
- Implemented an animated day/night cycle, sun, moon, stars, clouds, lighting, and sky-color transitions.
- Started a local server on port 3002.
- Verified the inline JavaScript parses successfully.
- Captured and visually inspected screenshots of the welcome screen and live game.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Open `http://localhost:3002/` and exercise the movement, mining, and placement interactions.
2. Test the mobile viewport and touch controls.
3. Add a favicon or other small refinements if desired.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.

## Important Context
- The final screenshot was saved at `screenshots/play.jpg`.
- Browser console showed only a missing `favicon.ico` 404 and WebGL read-pixel warnings.
- The Three.js implementation depends on the CDN URL `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js`.
